steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist and update titles
access_token = _mem['s6']['access_token']
playlist_genres = {}
for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    song_ids = pl['song_ids']
    genre_counts = {}
    for sid in song_ids:
        g = song_genres[sid]
        genre_counts[g] = genre_counts.get(g, 0) + 1
    most_common = max(genre_counts, key=genre_counts.get)
    playlist_genres[pl_id] = most_common
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl_id}: {pl['title']} -> {new_title}")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pl_id, access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
    print(result)
